e.title: PBGC（美国养老金给付保证公司）：年金估值死亡率表与养老金保险统计
e.title_en: PBGC (US Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation): annuity valuation mortality tables and pension insurance statistics
e.title_hk: PBGC（美國養老金給付保證公司）：年金估值死亡率表與養老金保險統計
e.summary: 美国养老金给付保险机构：ERISA 4044/4050 死亡率表与退休假设（用于困境终止时年金估值），以及单一/多雇主计划的养老金保险数据
e.summary_en: The US pension benefit insurer: ERISA 4044/4050 mortality tables and retirement assumptions for valuing annuities in distress terminations, plus single- and multiemployer pension insurance data
e.summary_hk: 美國養老金給付保險機構：ERISA 4044/4050 死亡率表與退休假設（用於困境終止時年金估值），以及單一／多雇主計劃的養老金保險數據
e.body:
**PBGC（Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation，美国养老金给付保证公司）** 是**美国的养老金给付保险机构**——为私营确定给付（DB）计划的参与者提供退休金保障。本条目属本轮的**养老金与退休保障数据层**，也是**形态上很特别的一条**：它本身就是**「养老金 + 保险」的结合体**（用保险机制承接计划终止风险），而池内此前**PBGC 相关条目为 0**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：首页 71.5KB；⭐ **估值表页 `/employers-practitioners/rates`（72.2KB），页面标题实测为「Mortality, retirement, and present value max guarantee」**，正文写明提供 **「ERISA 4044/4050 mortality tables」——用于「valuing annuities in distress and involuntary plan terminations（困境终止与非自愿终止中的年金估值）」以及 missing participants program 的现行与历史死亡率表**，并另有 **「ERISA 4044 retirement assumptions」（退休假设）**；⭐ **养老金保险数据页 `/about/reports/pension-insurance-data`（83.6KB）**，正文写明「Find **statistics for PBGC’s single-employer and multiemployer programs** and for the **private defined benefit pension system**」，分类含 **Net Financial Position of Program Claims（单一雇主）、Benefit Payments、Coverage、PBGC Premiums** 等，**并实测到可下载文件：`2023-pension-data-tables.pdf`、`2023-pension-data-tables.xlsx`、`2024-pension-data-tables.pdf`**（另有风险转移报告 PDF）；页面另提供**单一雇主与多雇主「当前缴纳 PBGC 保费的计划清单」**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「养老金保障机制」这一形态**——池内养老金相关条目多在产品与数据侧（[[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[hkmc]]、[[retirement-planning]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]），**而「当雇主计划终止、由谁兜底、按什么表估值」此前没有入口**；PBGC 的 **ERISA 4044/4050 死亡率表**正是**终止场景下的法定估值口径**，对做**养老金估值、年金化与计划终止分析**的学生是**可直接引用的官方表**。**② 程序性数据可用于实证**——「单一/多雇主计划统计」与「缴纳保费的计划清单」给出**美国 DB 体系的规模、覆盖率与保费分布**，适合做**养老金风险集中度与保障缺口**研究；**③ 与精算教科书主题直接对应**——年金估值、死亡率表选取、终止假设，都是课程主题在真实制度中的落地。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**两个关键页面的存在、标题与正文要点，以及四个数据文件的链接**，**但未下载或打开任何文件**；**②** 页面正文以**要点列表**呈现，**具体条目的完整内容（如表的年份范围）未逐项核实**；**③** PBGC 数据**受美国制度与法律框架限定**，**不能直接外推到其他市场**；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供精算建模工具。**核实说明**：首页（71.5KB）、估值表页（72.2KB）、养老金保险数据页（83.6KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取标题与正文；`2023/2024 pension-data-tables` 等文件链接在页面内实测可见；**未下载文件**。
e.body_en:
**PBGC (Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation)** is **the United States’ pension benefit insurer**, protecting participants in private defined-benefit (DB) plans. This entry belongs to this round’s **pension and retirement security data layer** and is **unusual in form**: it is itself a **combination of pension and insurance** (an insurance mechanism absorbing plan-termination risk), and the corpus previously held **zero PBGC-related entries**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is 71.5KB; ⭐ the **valuation page `/employers-practitioners/rates` (72.2KB)** has the **measured title "Mortality, retirement, and present value max guarantee"** and states that it provides **"ERISA 4044/4050 mortality tables" — for "valuing annuities in distress and involuntary plan terminations"** and for the missing participants programme, current and historical, plus separate **"ERISA 4044 retirement assumptions"**; ⭐ the **pension insurance data page `/about/reports/pension-insurance-data` (83.6KB)** states "Find **statistics for PBGC’s single-employer and multiemployer programs** and for the **private defined benefit pension system**", with categories including **Net Financial Position of Program Claims (single-employer), Benefit Payments, Coverage and PBGC Premiums**, and **measured downloadable files: `2023-pension-data-tables.pdf`, `2023-pension-data-tables.xlsx`, `2024-pension-data-tables.pdf`** (plus a risk-transfer report PDF); the site also offers **current lists of single-employer and multiemployer plans paying PBGC premiums**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "pension protection mechanism" form** — pension entries in the corpus sit mostly on the product and data side ([[mpf-fund-platform]], [[apra-superannuation-statistics]], [[hkmc]], [[retirement-planning]], [[longevity-mortality-investor]]), while **"when an employer plan terminates, who stands behind it and by which table is it valued" had no entry point**; PBGC’s **ERISA 4044/4050 mortality tables** are precisely **the statutory valuation basis in termination scenarios**, making them **officially citable tables** for students working on **pension valuation, annuitisation and plan termination**. **② The programme data supports empirical work** — the single/multiemployer statistics and the premium-paying plan lists give **the scale, coverage and premium distribution of the US DB system**, useful for research on **pension risk concentration and protection gaps**; **③ it maps directly onto textbook topics** — annuity valuation, mortality table selection and termination assumptions are course themes landing in a real regime.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the existence, titles and key body points of two pages and the links to four data files**, **but downloaded and opened no file**; **②** the pages present **bullet-point summaries**, and **the full contents of individual items (such as the year ranges of the tables) were not verified item by item**; **③** PBGC data is **bounded by the US institutional and legal framework** and **cannot be extrapolated to other markets**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site offers actuarial modelling tools**. **Verification note**: the homepage (71.5KB), the valuation page (72.2KB) and the pension insurance data page (83.6KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and body text read; the `2023/2024 pension-data-tables` file links were observed on the page; **no file was downloaded**.
e.body_hk:
**PBGC（Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation，美國養老金給付保證公司）** 是**美國的養老金給付保險機構**，為私營確定給付（DB）計劃參與者提供退休金保障。本條目屬本輪**養老金與退休保障數據層**，**形態上很特別**：它本身就是**「養老金 + 保險」的結合體**；池內此前 **PBGC 相關條目為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 71.5KB；⭐ **估值表頁（72.2KB）標題實測為「Mortality, retirement, and present value max guarantee」**，正文提供 **「ERISA 4044/4050 mortality tables」——用於「valuing annuities in distress and involuntary plan terminations」**，另有 **「ERISA 4044 retirement assumptions」**；⭐ **養老金保險數據頁（83.6KB）**正文寫明提供**單一與多雇主計劃及私營 DB 體系的統計**，分類含 **計劃索賠淨財務狀況、給付支付、覆蓋、PBGC 保費**，**並實測到可下載檔案 `2023/2024-pension-data-tables`（PDF 與 XLSX）**；頁面另提供**當前繳納 PBGC 保費的計劃清單**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「養老金保障機制」這一形態**——池內養老金條目多在產品與數據側（[[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[hkmc]]、[[retirement-planning]]），**而「計劃終止時由誰兜底、按什麼表估值」此前沒有入口**；**ERISA 4044/4050 死亡率表**正是**終止場景的法定估值口徑**；**② 程序性數據可做實證**（美國 DB 體系規模、覆蓋與保費分佈）；**③ 與課程主題直接對應**（年金估值、死亡率表選取、終止假設）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**兩個頁面的存在、標題與正文要點，以及四個數據檔案鏈接**，**但未下載或打開任何檔案**；**②** 頁面以**要點列表**呈現，**個別條目完整內容未逐項核實**；**③** PBGC 數據**受美國制度框架限定，不能直接外推**；**④** 本詞條**不主張**該站提供精算建模工具。**核實說明**：三頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未下載檔案**。
